sections.title: Day 50 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 掌握物流索賠、責任認定與補償相關字彙

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜Only after 倒裝、要求式假設語氣、過去反事實條件句、未來時間子句、主詞一致
sections.markdown:
主題：**Only after 倒裝、要求式假設語氣、過去反事實條件句、未來時間子句、主詞一致**

### 規則 1｜Only after 倒裝

Only after 置於句首時，主句使用助動詞倒裝。

> Only after the inspection ended did the carrier accept liability.

### 規則 2｜要求式假設語氣

recommend/request/insist + that + S + 原形動詞；被動為 be + p.p.

> The supervisor recommended that the item be inspected again.

### 規則 3｜過去反事實條件句

Had + S + p.p., S + would have + p.p.

> Had the customer discarded the packaging, the investigation would have been harder.

### 規則 4｜未來時間子句

as soon as / once / when 引導未來時間子句時用現在式。

> We will ship the replacement as soon as the warehouse confirms the address.

### 規則 5｜主詞一致

together with 不改變主要主詞的單複數。

> The receipt, together with the photographs, is attached.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Damage Claim Evidence
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Customer: I uploaded the photos yesterday. Can the claim be approved now? Agent: The photos help, but the warehouse handover record still shows the cartons as undamaged. We need the carrier's delivery scan before we can make a final decision. Customer: So the claim was rejected? Agent: Not at all. It is still under review. If the scan shows damage at delivery, the inspection fee may be waived. Customer: What should I do now? Agent: Keep the original packaging and do not return anything until we send written instructions.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Replacement Shipping Options
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: The replacement parts must arrive by ten fifteen Tuesday morning. We also need signature confirmation and insurance. The shipping budget is one hundred sixty dollars. Man: Option A arrives too late. Option B has no signature confirmation, and Option D has no insurance. Woman: Then Option C is the only one that meets all requirements. Please book it and email the tracking number to the client.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Claim Portal Update
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Attention, customers. The claims portal will undergo maintenance on Thursday from 6 P.M. to 9 P.M. Claims already submitted will remain in the system. Customers whose filing deadline falls on Thursday may submit supporting documents until Friday at noon. This extension applies only to documents that could not be uploaded during the maintenance window. Automatic reminders may still show the original deadline.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Cargo Damage Claim Evidence and Compensation
sections.markdown:
限時：**10 分 0 秒**。

### Cargo Damage Claim Policy

> A claim for damaged cargo must include a delivery receipt, photographs of the outer packaging, and an inspection report. Claims submitted within five calendar days of delivery are eligible for standard review. If damage is documented at the time of delivery, the inspection fee may be waived. A $120 compensation credit is available only when carrier liability is confirmed. Credits are applied to the next invoice, not the current one.

用途：參考文件

### Shipment Record

> Seaview Components received a shipment on November 3. The delivery receipt was signed at 10:12 A.M. and noted that two cartons were crushed. Photographs were uploaded on November 4. The inspection report, completed November 5, confirmed damage to four units. Seaview submitted its claim on November 6. The current invoice total is $1,460.

用途：參考文件

### Carrier Review Update

> The carrier confirms that the cartons were damaged before handover to Seaview Components. Liability is therefore accepted. The inspection fee will be waived, and a $120 compensation credit will appear on the next invoice. The current invoice remains $1,460. Seaview does not need to resubmit the claim. A replacement shipment is scheduled for November 9.

用途：參考文件

### 閱讀文章

> Subject: Revised Claim Evidence Procedure
> 
> Beginning Monday, customers reporting damaged deliveries must upload both package photographs and the signed delivery receipt through the claims portal.
> 
> [1] _____
> 
> If any required document is missing, the claim [2] _____ as incomplete and the customer will receive an email notice.
> 
> Claims already accepted before Monday do not need to be resubmitted. [3] _____, any new evidence added after Monday must be uploaded through the portal rather than sent by email.
> 
> Customers should keep the original packaging until the investigation is complete.
> 
> [4] _____

sections.title: ⑨ Day 50 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 47、Day 48、Day 49**。

### 複習重點
- Requested ≠ Approved
- Provisional ≠ Confirmed
- Carrier liability 與 compensation qualification
- Current invoice 與 next invoice credit 的區分
- Listening 中 under review 與 rejected 的差異

### 錯題標籤
- `G`：Grammar
- `INV`：Inversion
- `SUBJ`：Subjunctive
- `TIME`：Timeline/Time Clause
- `COND`：Conditional
- `L`：Listening
- `DETAIL`：Key Detail
- `IMP`：Implication
- `I`：Information Integration
- `BUD`：Budget Constraint
- `E`：Exception
- `U`：Updated Information
- `T`：Timeline

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- 複習今日 30 個單字，選 8 個各造一個商務句子。
- Part 5 15 題首次限時 4 分鐘，第二輪 3 分 30 秒。
- Part 6 4 題重做，說明每題的上下文邏輯。
- Listening 三組各練兩次，第二輪使用 TTS 1.1x 且不看逐字稿。
- 重新整理 Seaview claim 的證據鏈：delivery receipt → photos → inspection → carrier liability → waiver/credit。
- Day 50 Quiz 第二輪限時 5 分 30 秒，記錄首次答案、耗時與 errorTags。
